import pandas as pd

# Read source tables
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_65/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_65/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# The target columns other than Timepoint are drug names with float values.
# Source0 has Mouse ID and Drug (categorical), Source1 has Mouse ID, Timepoint, Tumor Volume (mm3), Metastatic Sites.
# The target columns are drug names with float values, presumably tumor volumes per drug per timepoint.
# We need to join on Mouse ID, then pivot the Drug column from source0 to columns with tumor volume values from source1.

# Join on Mouse ID
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Pivot the data: index=Timepoint, columns=Drug, values=Tumor Volume (mm3)
pivot = joined.pivot_table(index="Timepoint", columns="Drug", values="Tumor Volume (mm3)", aggfunc='mean')

# The target schema drugs are:
target_drugs = ['Capomulin', 'Ceftamin', 'Infubinol', 'Ketapril', 'Naftisol', 'Placebo', 'Propriva', 'Ramicane', 'Stelasyn', 'Zoniferol']

# Some drugs may be missing in pivot columns, add them with NaN if missing
for drug in target_drugs:
    if drug not in pivot.columns:
        pivot[drug] = float('nan')

# Reorder columns to match target schema
pivot = pivot[target_drugs]

# Reset index to bring Timepoint as a column
result = pivot.reset_index()

# The target examples show float values for drugs, so keep as float
# The target has 5 rows, presumably 5 distinct timepoints, so group by Timepoint and aggregate mean is done by pivot_table

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_65/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
